answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 9146 Country: KW Title: My dad gives away his hard earned money as loan to people with no returning back from them many have cheated him he is also not religious like my mom who is very religious and sincere my dad is also behind a lady to get married allah knows what is wrong with him lately she saw a dream that there is some thing put in their house mayb thru blackmagic,once she saw a black cat enter the bedroom and did not come out what does this mean also there is no barakat in the house all tensions only please help Question: My dad gives away his hard earned money as loan to people with no returning back from them many have cheated him he is also not religious like my mom who is very religious and sincere my dad is also behind a lady to get married allah knows what is wrong with him lately she saw a dream that there is some thing put in their house mayb thru blackmagic,once she saw a black cat enter the bedroom and did not come out what does this mean also there is no barakat in the house all tensions only please help Answer ID: 9146 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2337/1824=H/1429) The house attracts blessing if salah , recitation of Quran and following of sunnah is done therein, tension and stress decreases rather comes to an end. Negligence in following Shariah, recitation of Quran and prayers is a cause of restlessness and tension. Whatever you have written is neither black magic nor anything else, but the meaning of the dream is that the family members are very much negligent of Shariah. May Allah protect us, Amen! Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
